Implemented the duplicate-file fix in `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts`.

`injectFilesToPath` now:

- Replaces an existing file when the incoming `GeneratedFile.name` matches.
- Appends files that do not already exist.
- Preserves the existing folder and file ordering.

Validation:

- `run_tests` completed with no new failures.
- The only remaining failure is the pre-existing ZIP publisher `ENOENT` failure reported by the baseline suite.

Updated `underscore.js` to use direct own-property checks in `groupBy` and `countBy` instead of `_.has`, which treats array keys as deep property paths.

This preserves array keys through JavaScript’s normal key coercion, so repeated `[1, 2]` values correctly share the `"1,2"` bucket.

Validation:
- `run_tests`: 1561/1562 passed
- No regressions introduced
- Remaining failure is pre-existing: `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions`
- `git diff --check` passed

Updated `injectFilesToPath` in `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts` so generated files replace template files with the same filename instead of being appended as duplicates.

Validation:
- `run_tests`: no failures introduced.
- One pre-existing failure remains in `teleport-publisher-zip` due to a missing disk-project ZIP path.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

Implemented the `groupBy` array-key regression fix in `underscore.js`.

Changes:
- Replaced `_.has(result, key)` with an own-property check in `groupBy`.
- Applied the same correction to `countBy`, which had the same array-path issue.
- Preserved deep-path behavior for the public `_.has` API.

Validation:
- `1561/1562` tests pass.
- The remaining failure, `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions`, is pre-existing and unchanged.

Updated `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts` so `injectFilesToPath`:

- Replaces an existing file when the incoming file has the same name.
- Preserves unrelated template files.
- Appends new files as before.
- Uses the latest definition if duplicate incoming files share a name.

Validation with `run_tests` found no regressions. The suite still reports one pre-existing ZIP publisher failure caused by a missing output directory.

Updated `underscore.js` so `groupBy` and `countBy` use an own-property check directly instead of `_.has`. This preserves array-valued grouping keys, which `_.has` incorrectly interprets as deep property paths in 1.9.

Validation:
- `run_tests`: 1561/1562 passed
- No regressions introduced
- Remaining failure is the pre-existing `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions` failure
- Focused targeting is unsupported by the test runner, so the full suite ran again

Updated `packages/teleport-project-generator/src/utils.ts` so `injectFilesToPath`:

- Replaces an existing file when `name` and `fileType` match.
- Adds the file when no matching path exists.
- Preserves files with the same name but different file types.

Validation: `run_tests` completed with no introduced failures. The single remaining failure is pre-existing and unrelated: the ZIP publisher test cannot find its expected output archive.

Updated `underscore.js` so `groupBy` checks bucket existence with a direct own-property lookup instead of `_.has`.

This fixes array-valued grouping keys, which `_.has` interpreted as deep paths in 1.9. Equal arrays now correctly group into the same bucket.

Validation:
- 1,561 of 1,562 tests pass.
- The sole failure is pre-existing: `#1929 Typed Array constructors are functions`.
- No new failures were introduced.

Updated `lua/bufferline/offset.lua` to recursively inspect nested window-layout branches before determining the leftmost and rightmost sidebar windows.

This allows offsets configured for `filetype = "undotree"` to work when Undotree is nested within Neovim’s split layout, while preserving existing behavior for NvimTree and other sidebars.

Validation:

- Initial `run_tests`: passed
- Post-change `run_tests`: passed
- 0 failures, 0 errors
- No test files modified

Implemented `allow_partial_matching` for `grade_code()`.

Changes:
- Added `allow_partial_matching = TRUE` while preserving existing positional argument behavior.
- Propagated the option through recursive `detect_mistakes()` calls.
- When set to `FALSE`, uniquely abbreviated parameter names now produce feedback listing the abbreviated and full names.
- Updated `grade_code` documentation in `R/grade_code.R` and `man/grade_code.Rd`.

Updated `lua/bufferline/offset.lua` to recursively inspect nested leftmost and rightmost layout subtrees when matching offset filetypes.

This allows offsets configured for `undotree` to work even when the plugin creates nested or stacked sidebar windows, while preserving existing NvimTree and regular split behavior.
